services.name: Architecture
services.shortDescription: Buildings designed for place, climate, and life.
services.description: From intimate private residences to corporate offices and commercial buildings — buildings that respond honestly to their site, climate, and the people who use them. Every project starts with the site and ends with the door handle.

services.name: Interior Designing
services.shortDescription: Spaces that feel as good as they look.
services.description: Interiors built around material honesty, considered light, and the way spaces are actually lived in. Custom furniture design, material selection, lighting plans, and finishes worked into a single coherent narrative.

services.name: Landscaping
services.description: Site-responsive landscape design — native vegetation, passive water management, hardscape detailing, and outdoor living spaces. Landscape and architecture treated as one continuous design problem.

services.name: Master Planning
services.description: Master planning for residential townships, institutional campuses, and mixed-use developments. Organized around community life, climate, and the long arc of time — from concept through phased delivery.

services.name: Vaastu Consultancy
services.description: Vaastu Shastra principles integrated into contemporary plans — for clients who want their home or workplace to follow Vaastu without sacrificing modern design. Honest, practical, non-dogmatic consultation.

services.name: Turnkey Solutions & Site Supervision
services.shortDescription: From first sketch to final handover.
services.description: End-to-end project delivery — design, drawings, vendor coordination, site supervision, and final handover. The studio takes full responsibility so the client deals with one team from start to finish.
